an9.3:1.1: evaṃ me sutaṃ: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā cālikāyaṃ viharati cālikāya pabbate.
an9.3:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā meghiyo bhagavato upaṭṭhāko hoti,
an9.3:1.3: atha kho āyasmā meghiyo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho āyasmā meghiyo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an9.3:2.1: atha kho āyasmā meghiyo pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya jantugāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi:
an9.3:2.2: jantugāme piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena kimikālāya nadiyā tīraṃ tenupasaṅkami.
an9.3:2.3: addasā kho āyasmā meghiyo kimikālāya nadiyā tīre jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno ambavanaṃ pāsādikaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ.
an9.3:2.5: pāsādikaṃ vatidaṃ ambavanaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ, alaṃ vatidaṃ kulaputtassa padhānatthikassa padhānāya.
an9.3:2.6: sace maṃ bhagavā anujāneyya, āgaccheyyāhaṃ imaṃ ambavanaṃ padhānāyāti.
an9.3:3.1: atha kho āyasmā meghiyo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā meghiyo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an9.3:4.1: idhāhaṃ bhante pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya jantugāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ.
an9.3:4.2: jantugāme piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena kimikālāya nadiyā tīraṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃ.
an9.3:4.3: addasaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante, kimikālāya nadiyā tīre jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno ambavanaṃ pāsādikaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ,
an9.3:4.7: sace maṃ bhagavā anujāneyya āgaccheyyāhaṃ imaṃ ambavanaṃ padhānāyāti.
an9.3:4.8: sace maṃ bhagavā anujāneyya gaccheyyāhaṃ taṃ ambavanaṃ padhānāyāti.
an9.3:4.9: āgamehi tāva meghiya, ekakamhā tāva yāva aññāpi koci bhikkhu āgacchatīti.
an9.3:5.1: dutiyampi kho āyasmā meghiyo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an9.3:5.2: bhagavato bhante, natthi kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyaṃ, natthi katassa paticayo.
an9.3:5.3: mayhaṃ kho pana bhante, atthi uttariṃ karaṇīyaṃ, atthi katassa paticayo.
an9.3:5.4: sace maṃ bhagavā anujāneyya, gaccheyyāhaṃ taṃ ambavanaṃ padhānāyāti.
an9.3:5.5: āgamehi tāva meghiya, ekakamhā tāva yāva aññopi koci bhikkhu āgacchatīti.
an9.3:6.1: tatiyampi kho āyasmā meghiyo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an9.3:6.2: bhagavato bhante, natthi kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyaṃ, natthi katassa vā paticayo.
an9.3:6.3: mayhaṃ kho pana bhante, atthi uttariṃ karaṇīyaṃ, atthi katassa paticayo.
an9.3:6.4: sace maṃ bhagavā anujāneyya, gaccheyyāhaṃ taṃ ambavanaṃ padhānāyāti.
an9.3:6.5: padhānanti kho meghiya vadamānaṃ kinti vadeyyāma,
an9.3:7.1: atha kho āyasmā meghiyo uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena taṃ ambavanaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā taṃ ambavanaṃ ajjhogāhetvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisīdi.
an9.3:7.2: atha kho āyasmato meghiyassa tasmiṃ ambavane viharantassa yebhuyyena tayo pāpakā akusalā vitakkā samudācaranti. seyyathīdaṃ:
an9.3:7.5: acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho,
an9.3:7.6: saddhāya vata camhi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
an9.3:7.7: atha ca pana imehi tīhi pāpakehi akusalehi vitakkehi anvāsatto
an9.3:8.1: atha kho āyasmā meghiyo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā meghiyo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an9.3:9.1: idha mayhaṃ bhante tasmiṃ ambavane viharantassa yebhuyyena tayo pāpakā akusalā vitakkā samudācaranti. seyyathīdaṃ:
an9.3:9.4: acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho,
an9.3:9.6: atha ca panimehi tīhi pāpakehi akusalehi vitakkehi anvāpatto
an9.3:10.1: aparipakkāya meghiya cetovimuttiyā pañcadhammā paripakkāya saṃvattanti.
an9.3:10.3: idha meghiya, bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto hoti kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko.
an9.3:10.4: aparipakkāya meghiya ceto vimuttiyā ayaṃ paṭhamo dhammo paripakkāya saṃvattati.
an9.3:11.1: puna caparaṃ meghiya bhikkhu sīlavā hoti pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu
an9.3:11.2: aparipakkāya meghiya, cetovimuttiyā ayaṃ dutiyo dhammo paripakkāya saṃvattati.
an9.3:12.1: puna caparaṃ meghiya bhikkhu yāyaṃ kathā abhisallekhikā cetovivaraṇasappāyā seyyathīdaṃ: appicchakathā …pe… evarūpiyā kathāya nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhiṃ
an9.3:12.2: aparipakkāya meghiya, cetovimuttiyā ayaṃ tatiyo dhammo paripakkāya saṃvattati.
an9.3:13.1: puna caparaṃ meghiya bhikkhu āraddhaviriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya, thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
an9.3:13.2: aparipakkāya meghiya cetovimuttiyā ayaṃ catuttho dhammo paripakkāya saṃvattati.
an9.3:14.1: puna caparaṃ meghiya bhikkhu paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
an9.3:14.2: aparipakkāya meghiya cetovimuttiyā ayaṃ pañcamo dhammo paripakkāya saṃvattati.
an9.3:15.1: kalyāṇamittassetaṃ meghiya bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ kalyāṇasahāyassa kalyāṇasampavaṅkassa
an9.3:15.2: sīlavā bhavissati pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharissati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an9.3:16.1: kalyāṇamittassetaṃ meghiya bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ kalyāṇasahāyassa kalyāṇasampavaṅkassa:
an9.3:16.2: yāyaṃ kathā abhisallekhikā cetovivaraṇasappāyā, seyyathīdaṃ; appicchakathā …pe… vimuttiñāṇadassanakathā, evarūpiyā kathāya nikāmalābhī bhavissati akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
an9.3:17.1: kalyāṇamittassetaṃ meghiya bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ kalyāṇasahāyassa, kalyāṇasampavaṅkassa āraddhaviriyo viharissati …pe… kusalesu dhammesu.
an9.3:18.1: kalyāṇamittassetaṃ meghiya bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ kalyāṇasahāyassa kalyāṇasampavaṅkassa: paññavā bhavissati udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā. 6-9
an9.3:19.1: tena ca pana meghiya bhikkhuno imesu pañcasu dhammesu patiṭṭhāya cattāro dhammā uttariṃ bhāvetabbā:
an9.3:19.2: asubhā bhāvetabbā rāgassa pahānāya, mettā bhāvetabbā vyāpādassa pahānāya, ānāpānasati bhāvetabbā vitakkupacchedāya, aniccasaññā bhāvetabbā asmimānasamugghātāya.
an9.3:19.4: anattasaññī asmimānasamugghātaṃ pāpuṇāti. diṭṭheva dhamme nibbānanti.
